thesis: Recent revenue growth of 53.3% and constructive price/momentum evidence give the bull the clearest combined demand-and-trend support. This is a conditional directional ruling, not a cross-currency fair-value claim.
strongest_counterexample: Reporting-currency and ADR ambiguity prevent reliable financial valuation, and reinvestment and geopolitical risks may overwhelm strong sales.
invalidation_conditions: Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive monthly reports of negative year-on-year revenue growth.
Analyst-selected review rule, not a sourced forecast: reassess this ruling if two consecutive completed-session weekly closes below the contemporaneous 200-day moving average.
evidence_gaps: Verified ADR conversion, statement currency and incremental foundry returns.
Underlying statement periods and forward-estimate dates are not fully supplied.
decisive_factors: Monthly sales and constructive technicals provide real demand and execution evidence
Strong monthly demand and a constructive technical setup are the strongest counterarguments to waiting
